versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service DynamicallyDefineDataIdenti- fier (0x2C), the Dcm module shall check if the requested Source-DIDs are supported in the current session (see configuration parameter of referenced DID DcmDspDidRead- SessionRef )). If not, the Dcm module shall send a NRC 0x31 (RequestOutOfRange).
